entries.en: Hifumi and I roamed the[n]snowy Shibuya streets[n]for quite some time...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Christmas requires a great amount[n]of stamina...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Weaving through crowds of people...[n]It's as if I have become a knight...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I hope that this will make up for my lack[n]of daily exercise...
Let's relax.
It was fun.[clr 27]
You want a massage?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes, it was.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: H-Huh?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You've been staring at me this entire time.[n]Is there something you'd like to say...?
Merry Christmas.
You're imagining things.
I'm happy that you're here.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh, yes. Merry Christmas...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That's...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...how I feel about you as well.
I won't be able to see Hifumi[n]again after tomorrow...
We spent a long time talking...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh dear. I almost forgot something[n]very important...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's nothing special, but I wanted[n]you to have it...
Thanks.[clr 27]
I thought you were my present.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You're welcome...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That is not something one should say[n]to his former instructor!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...Just kidding. It's your fault for always[n]joking around with me, you know?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I wanted to talk to you about[n]something today...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'm really glad you're safe.[n]I believed in you...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It just felt wrong... How could they[n]arrest someone so righteous? I knew[n]it had to be a mistake...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: So you being here does make me[n]happy... more than you realize. Still...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: As far as the public knows, you are in[n]custody as we speak...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That's why I'm worried... I can't help[n]but feel something terrible might[n]happen to you...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If that happens, there's no telling what[n]they'll do to you or your teammates.
entries.uk: Якщо так станеться, хтозна, що вони[n]зроблять із тобою чи твоїми[n]товаришами.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There's even the possibility that they'll[n]fabricate a crime and move to arrest[n]you all.
entries.uk: Можливо навіть, що вони сфабрикують[n]злочин і візьмуться[n]заарештувати вас усіх.

entries.en: I have to turn myself in to[n]make sure Hifumi stays safe...
But telling her about it would[n]only cause her to panic...
It's nothing.
I'm sorry.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh... I see...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Sorry, I should mind my own business...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I'm going to go.
I'll walk you back.
Be careful.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: No, it's fine.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I will.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: By the way, I could perceive that you[n]were acting different than usual.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I wish you had talked to me about it.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Thank you for today.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Good night.
I made Hifumi worry...
Even so, this is the only way...
